title: rtl-files.json — per-child RTL file layout (authored by assemble from the reaped child reports)
description: Which files each child wrote and which include directories they `include from. Every downstream filelist is GENERATED from this: simulation's rtl_filelist.f, synthesis's rtl_load.tcl, lint-cdc's scripts/filelist.txt. Keys are manifest child names. files[] order within a child is the child's declared dependency order; children follow manifest order. An empty object is a legitimate transient state before wave 2 has reaped any child; the roster requirement lives in the post exit gate.

files.description: Paths relative to the rtl-design stage root, in dependency order. The child authors its own file layout — specification defines RTL modules, not files.

incdirs.description: Include directories the child's files `include from, relative to the rtl-design stage root. Omitted or empty when the child uses no `include. Downstream emits these in each tool's own syntax; they are never joined into a text line for a reader to split apart again.
